# Raleigh-Durham October 17-18 2014

**You learn** designing, prototyping and coding with the help from our coaches.

**You need** your own laptop, curiosity and a sprinkle of imagination!

**Want to help?** We are looking for volunteers and Rails coaches. [Email us](mailto:railsgirlsrdu@gmail.com).

Together we're building better developers to take on the Triangle’s technology economy.

* * *

### Partners

Rails Girls Raleigh-Durham is co-organized with our awesome partners:

[Triangle.rb](http://www.meetup.com/raleighrb/) and [Girl Develop It RDU](http://www.girldevelopit.com/chapters/raleigh-durham)

### FAQ

**How much does the workshop cost?** Nothing, it's free! You just need to be excited!

**Who is this aimed for?** Women of any age with basic knowledge of working with a computer. We’ve had people of all ages taking part.

**Can men attend?** Yes, but you need to be accompanied by an interested lady. Also, girls are given a priority.

**I know how to program - How can I help?** We’re also looking for people to be coaches. We’ll have a two-three hour workshop before the event to walk you through the curriculum. [Email us](mailto:railsgirlsrdu@gmail.com)
